moments.situ: Night companion refused a continence change. You are the only care assistant on the unit.

choices.t: She's wet, it has to be done now. I'll insist.

form.observation: Refused the change. I will insist.

choices.t: Step back. Check pain and toileting, then try again with a colleague and tell the nurse.

form.observation: Refused the change. Checked comfort and toileting. Colleague will try. Nurse told.

moments.situ: She is restless. A colleague says to give something from the cabinet.

choices.t: Give it from the cabinet and write that I did.

form.observation: Restless. A colleague pointed to the cabinet.

choices.t: Do not give it. Tell the nurse.

form.observation: Restless. Cabinet suggestion refused. Nurse told.

moments.situ: A resident who arrived six days ago is at the unit door in her coat, asking for a taxi.

choices.t: Log a refusal of care and retry later.

form.observation: At the door asking for a taxi. Arrived six days ago.

choices.t: Log exit-seeking and review her integration plan.

form.observation: At the door asking for a taxi. Arrived six days ago. Walked back, calmer.

moments.situ: A resident of eight months is pacing the corridor and trying doors. A colleague calls it sundowning.

choices.t: Record sundowning and ask the physician for something to calm her.

form.observation: Pacing the corridor and trying doors again this afternoon.

choices.t: Check toilet, thirst, glasses and the lighting, then write what you saw.

form.observation: Pacing at the corridor doors. Glasses were in the drawer. Lights were dimmed last week.
